article.title: vivo以ENHYPEN三位成員推廣V80，合作覆蓋九個市場
article.summary: vivo委任ENHYPEN成員JUNGWON、JAKE及SUNGHOON為V80的vivo Friends，合作涵蓋九個市場。
highlights: 名單包括新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國、印尼、菲律賓、越南、柬埔寨、緬甸及台灣。
推廣內容結合時尚、個人風格與人像攝影；V80在東南亞按市場推出。
article.why: 區域品牌可把代言合作與一項具體使用情境連結，並按各市場的產品推出時間安排內容。
article.next_step: 核對市場名單、代言素材授權及產品開售時間，再為各地安排相應落地頁。
article.detail: 據Marketing-Interactive報道，三位成員以V80拍攝人像，讓個人風格成為活動創意的一部分。vivo把人像攝影與年輕消費者的自我表達連結。區域合作名單及產品推出進度各有範圍，行銷團隊可先核對每個市場實際可用的商品頁和素材，再決定是否共用同一組廣告及行動呼籲。
article.title_en: vivo taps three ENHYPEN members for V80 across nine markets
article.summary_en: vivo appointed ENHYPEN's JUNGWON, JAKE and SUNGHOON as vivo Friends for the V80 across nine markets.
highlights_en: The list covers Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Cambodia, Myanmar and Taiwan.
Content combines fashion, personal style and portraits. V80 will roll out market by market in Southeast Asia.
article.why_en: Regional brands can tie ambassadors to a specific use case and align content with local product releases.
article.next_step_en: Check market coverage, asset rights and sales dates before preparing localized landing pages.
article.detail_en: Marketing-Interactive reports that the members shot portraits with the V80 and contributed their individual styles to the creative. vivo links portrait photography with younger consumers' self-expression. Teams can reconcile ambassador coverage with local product and asset availability before sharing ads or calls to action across markets.
